judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the planning/red-test phase and never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block. Because the production fix is completely missing, the new acceptance test in `src/orchestration/beforeSessionThrows.acceptance.test.ts` will fail when run. Furthermore, the candidate left `.lore/dod.md` checked into the repository, failed to remove the outdated 'Measured semantics' bullet from `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, failed to document what `afterSession` can assume about how much of the turn happened, and omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry.
